findings.title: Evolent Hip and Knee Arthroplasty (Commercial) Prior Authorization Tip Sheet
findings.quote: 3 months of symptoms and 3 months of non-operative treatment to include 2 different modalities
findings.note: Point32Health delegates hip/knee/shoulder surgery PA to Evolent (formerly NIA) for HPHC Commercial (point32health.org/provider/evolent-formerly-national-imaging-associates). Tip sheet also requires X-rays with Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3-4. Full guideline: 2026 Evolent MSK Surgery Guidelines on RadMD (eff 7/1/2026; PDF too large for full excerpting). CPT confirmed in-scope in Harvard Pilgrim HKS Utilization Review Matrix 2025 (www1.radmd.com/sites/default/files/2024-12/Harvard%20HKS%20Matrix%202025.pdf).

findings.title: Evolent Hip and Knee Arthroplasty (Commercial) Prior Authorization Tip Sheet
findings.quote: UKA - In addition to the documentation for duration of symptoms, type and duration of non-operative treatment and weight-bearing X-rays that show advanced arthritis limited to only one compartment
findings.note: Delegated to Evolent (NIA). Tip sheet notes 'Two separate requests are required for TKA vs. UKA.' Full criteria in 2026 Evolent MSK Surgery Guidelines (RadMD). CPT confirmed in-scope in Harvard Pilgrim HKS Utilization Review Matrix 2025 (www1.radmd.com/sites/default/files/2024-12/Harvard%20HKS%20Matrix%202025.pdf).

findings.title: Evolent Knee Arthroscopy Prior Authorization Tip Sheet (Evolent_CG-316)
findings.quote: Knee instability (as defined subjectively as 'giving way', 'giving out', 'buckling'
findings.note: Delegated to Evolent (NIA). Requires MRI-confirmed complete ACL tear plus no severe arthritis (KL grade 3-4); conservative care not required when instability criteria met. Full criteria in 2026 Evolent MSK Surgery Guidelines (RadMD). CPT confirmed in-scope in Harvard Pilgrim HKS Utilization Review Matrix 2025 (www1.radmd.com/sites/default/files/2024-12/Harvard%20HKS%20Matrix%202025.pdf).

findings.title: Evolent Knee Arthroscopy Prior Authorization Tip Sheet (Evolent_CG-316)
findings.quote: Failure of at least 6 weeks of non-operative treatment, including at least two of the following
findings.note: Delegated to Evolent (NIA). Requires symptomatic meniscal tear confirmed by MRI. Full criteria in 2026 Evolent MSK Surgery Guidelines (RadMD). CPT confirmed in-scope in Harvard Pilgrim HKS Utilization Review Matrix 2025 (www1.radmd.com/sites/default/files/2024-12/Harvard%20HKS%20Matrix%202025.pdf).

findings.title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review - Musculoskeletal Surgery (Hip Arthroplasty, CG 1761)
findings.quote: Symptomatic hip osteoarthritis confirmed by imaging studies (X-ray or MRI) AND failure of conservative treatment for a minimum of three (3) months
findings.note: Delegated to Evolent (NIA) per point32health.org. Public guideline on RadMD, eff 7/1/2026-7/1/2027. CPT confirmed in-scope in Harvard Pilgrim HKS Utilization Review Matrix 2025 (www1.radmd.com/sites/default/files/2024-12/Harvard%20HKS%20Matrix%202025.pdf).

findings.title: 2025 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review - Musculoskeletal Surgery v2 (Hip Arthroscopy, CG_1762)
findings.note: Delegated to Evolent (NIA). 2025 edition (verified) requires 'Failure of conservative treatment for a minimum of six (6) weeks within the last six (6) months' plus MRI/MR-arthrography-confirmed labral tear, but was superseded 7/1/2026. Current 2026 edition (same RadMD site) contains a Hip Arthroscopy section (TOC verified) but the 600+ page PDF exceeded fetch-tool limits for that section. CPT confirmed in-scope in Harvard Pilgrim HKS Utilization Review Matrix 2025 (www1.radmd.com/sites/default/files/2024-12/Harvard%20HKS%20Matrix%202025.pdf).

findings.title: Evolent Shoulder Arthroscopy Prior Authorization Tip Sheet (Evolent_CG-318)
findings.quote: Failure of at least 12 weeks of non-operative treatment, including at least three of the following criteria
findings.note: Delegated to Evolent (NIA). 12-week requirement applies to partial-thickness tears; full-thickness 1-5 cm tears exempt ('non-operative treatment not required'); MRI required for all requests. Full criteria in 2026 Evolent MSK Surgery Guidelines (RadMD). CPT confirmed in-scope in Harvard Pilgrim HKS Utilization Review Matrix 2025 (www1.radmd.com/sites/default/files/2024-12/Harvard%20HKS%20Matrix%202025.pdf).

findings.title: Evolent Shoulder Arthroplasty Prior Authorization Tip Sheet (Evolent_CG-317)
findings.quote: 3 months of non-operative treatment that includes at least ONE
findings.note: Delegated to Evolent (NIA). Also requires X-ray evidence of complete/near-complete joint space loss; cortisone injection within 12 weeks of surgery is an absolute contraindication. Full criteria in 2026 Evolent MSK Surgery Guidelines (RadMD). CPT confirmed in-scope in Harvard Pilgrim HKS Utilization Review Matrix 2025 (www1.radmd.com/sites/default/files/2024-12/Harvard%20HKS%20Matrix%202025.pdf).

findings.title: Evolent Shoulder Arthroscopy Prior Authorization Tip Sheet (Evolent_CG-318)
findings.quote: Failure of at least 12 weeks of non-operative treatment, including activity modification/avoidance of painful activities
findings.note: Delegated to Evolent (NIA). SLAP type 2/4 requires 12 wks conservative care; acute Bankart: acute instability event + acute labral tear on MRI/CT + age < 30. Full criteria in 2026 Evolent MSK Surgery Guidelines (RadMD). CPT confirmed in-scope in Harvard Pilgrim HKS Utilization Review Matrix 2025 (www1.radmd.com/sites/default/files/2024-12/Harvard%20HKS%20Matrix%202025.pdf).
